```{r}
PC_1_lollypop <- BAL_macrophages@reductions$pca@feature.loadings.projected %>% as_tibble(rownames = "ensg") %>% mutate(gene=genifiy(ensg)) %>% select(gene,PC_1)  %>% mutate(pc_squared=((PC_1)^2)) %>% top_n(pc_squared, n=20) %>% select(-pc_squared) %>% mutate(up_down=if_else(PC_1<0,"negative", "positive"), gene= fct_reorder(gene,PC_1)) %>% arrange(PC_1) %>% ggplot(aes(PC_1, gene,color=PC_1)) + geom_point(size=4)+ geom_segment(aes(x=0,xend=PC_1, y=gene,yend=gene), size=1)+theme_bw() +scale_color_distiller(
      palette = "RdYlBu", direction = -1)

PC_2_lollypop <- BAL_macrophages@reductions$pca@feature.loadings.projected %>% as_tibble(rownames = "ensg") %>% mutate(gene=genifiy(ensg)) %>% select(gene,PC_2)  %>% mutate(pc_squared=((PC_2)^2)) %>% top_n(pc_squared, n=20) %>% select(-pc_squared) %>% mutate(up_down=if_else(PC_2<0,"negative", "positive"), gene= fct_reorder(gene,PC_2)) %>% arrange(PC_2) %>% ggplot(aes(PC_2, gene,color=PC_2)) + geom_point(size=4)+ geom_segment(aes(x=0,xend=PC_2, y=gene,yend=gene), size=1) +theme_bw() +scale_color_distiller(palette = "RdYlBu", direction = -1)

PC_1_lollypop+PC_2_lollypop+plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1), heights = c(6))
```

```{r}
#VizDimLoadings(BAL_macrophages, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")
BAL_mac_new <- FindClusters(BAL_macrophages, resolution = 1.2)

majority_in_small_clusters <- tibble(seurat_clusters=BAL_mac_new$seurat_clusters,cluster= BAL_mac_new$Cluster) %>% count(seurat_clusters, cluster) %>% group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%  slice(which.max(n)) %>% mutate(small_majority_cluster=paste(seurat_clusters, cluster, sep="_"))

BAL_mac_new$small_majority_cluster<- tibble(seurat_clusters=BAL_mac_new$seurat_clusters) %>% left_join(majority_in_small_clusters, by="seurat_clusters") %>% pull(small_majority_cluster)
Idents(BAL_mac_new) <- "small_majority_cluster"

library("ggdendro")
BAL_mac_new <- BuildClusterTree(object=BAL_mac_new, assay = "RNA")

hclust_BAL_small <- my_hclust_BuildCLusterTree(BAL_mac_new, assay = "RNA")
clust_dendro_small <- ggdendrogram(hclust_BAL_small)
clust_dendro_small
DimPlot(BAL_mac_new)
DimPlot(BAL_mac_new, cells.highlight = WhichCells(object = BAL_mac_new, idents = "1_Monocytes"))
```
